title_sq: Vile me pishine ne shitje tek Flowers Hill Residence
description_sq:
Ofrojme per shitje Vile me Pishine ne Rezidencen Flowers Hill ne Lunder.
Vila ka siperfaqe ndertimi 280m2 dhe se bashku me siperfaqen e perbashket 286m2. Vila gjithashtu disponon verande me siperfaqee 27m2 dhe pishine prej 32m2. Siperfaqja e truallit eshte 182m2 dhe post parkimi per 2 makina me siperfaqe 30m2. 
Vila eshte e organizuar ne 2 kate mbi toke dhe 1 kat nen toke.
Kati -1 organizohet ne nje ambient ndenje, dhome gjumi, tualet, ambienti teknik dhe posti parkimit.
Kati 0 organizohet ne ambient ndenje i vecuar nga ambienti i gatimit, nje tualet dhe pjesa e verandes dhe e pishines.
Kati 1 organizohet ne 2 dhoma gjumi dhe 2 tualete.
Aktualisht vila eshte ne fazen e punimeve hidraulike dhe elektrike.
Residenca Flowers Hill ndodhet ne nje pozicion teper strategjik, shume prane TEG.
Per me shume informacion mund te na kontaktoni!
title_en: Villa with pool for sale at Flowers Hill Residence
description_en: We offer for sale Villa with Pool in Flowers Hill Residence in Lunder. The villa has a construction area of ​​280m2 and together with the common area of ​​286m2. The villa also has a veranda with an area of ​​27m2 and a swimming pool of 32m2. The surface of the land is 182m2 and parking post for 2 cars with a surface of 30m2. The villa is organized in 2 floors above ground and 1 floor below ground. Floor -1 is organized in a living room, bedroom, toilet, technical room and parking lot. Floor 0 is organized in a living area separated from the cooking area, a toilet and the part of the veranda and the pool. The 1st floor is organized into 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Currently, the villa is in the stage of hydraulic and electrical works. Residence Flowers Hill is located in a very strategic position, very close to TEG. For more information you can contact us!
